purpose: Explicitly authorized debug mock-ad outcomes; not real ad playback

gate.release: Hide all entry controls and reject open/completion. A forged or late mock completed callback must never reach reward success in release.
gate.switch_disabled: No mock dialog entry and no mock success; do not silently convert to local_trial success.

request_context.display: Only localized request-type label. Never render internal request id or technical context.
request_context.adapter: Map these semantic request types to real existing identifiers; do not manufacture a second reward ledger.

resolution: Resolve at most once; atomically lock both actions before dispatch.
Send result only to the captured existing business handler, keeping request type/context associated with original id.
Dialog never directly adds a bottle/slot/energy, plays an ad, or persists a reward.
Handler revalidates debug gate, request and attempt freshness, eligibility and not-already-consumed state.
Cancelled never grants reward. Completed is simulated test completion, not proof of real ad playback.
Duplicate or stale completion does not grant; late callback after cancel cannot resurrect the request.
Bonus bottle and bonus slot keep independent per-attempt eligibility; energy uses existing store and cap.
No invented success/failure screen or retry button. Preserve existing return route and status handling.
validation_matrix: debug+switch: completed, eligible existing handler processes at most once
double completed: at most one accepted result
debug switch off: no open or mock success
release: no entry and no mock success even for injected completed result
implementation_status: Static contract only, not runtime tested
